Pure opaque white seamless studio background, bright soft neutral frontal light with fill, no colored cast, no text, no labels, no border, no watermark. Preserve CG material finish, not a photograph or flat illustration. An original fictional sixteen-to-seventeen-year-old girl with chestnut twin braids, a mauve woven headband adorned with silver medallions and amethyst beads, bright violet eyes, soft youthful round cheeks, short balanced midface, a small natural nose and a lively gentle closed-mouth smile. Pink and ivory high-collar folklore robe with opaque fabric and delicate embroidery, colorful bead necklace. Wholesome, lively, cute adolescent character styling, light natural makeup and age-appropriate modest clothing; no mature glamour styling. Distinct original facial identity. Continue the pink-ivory embroidered folk dress into a continuous ankle-length pleated skirt with mauve embroidered border, muted rose sash and ivory embroidered flat boots. Modest age-appropriate clothing, lively healthy slim 166 cm adolescent build with 7.2 head proportions; keep youthful round face, not mature. Exactly nine head-and-shoulders portraits of this ONE SAME person in a clean 3 by 3 equal panel expression grid, every face front-facing eye-level same scale and consistent face hair clothes. Row1 neutral, gentle closed-mouth smile, happy open smile; row2 surprise mouth O, worried frown, quiet sadness; row3 focused anger, skeptical raised eyebrow, playful small wink. Expressions clearly distinct but attractive and natural. Full hair and shoulders inside each cell. Square overall canvas. Narrow white gutters, no text.
